name: clickai-skills
description: Portable skills for AI agents — a multi-model advisory board, a twelve-skill team-workflow pack for tracked multi-session development, a media-ingest skill that turns recordings and URLs into evidence, and the reference for writing documents agents consume.

interface.shortDescription: Playbooks for planning, deciding, and shipping with agents
interface.longDescription: Self-contained playbooks any agent can read: a multi-model advisory board for hard decisions, relentless grilling to pressure-test a plan, decision maps for foggy work, throwaway prototypes, autonomous research lanes, ticket filing, human-step wizards, session handoffs, an orchestration protocol for parallel lanes, an adversarial review that breaks changes before they ship, and a skeptic-verified state review of the codebase itself.
